You review SheDrive as a clickable product demo.

## Validate

- login to booking flow
- verification flow
- rider matching flow
- active trip and SOS flow
- trip completion and rating
- driver request handling
- admin queue walkthroughs when available

## Output

- broken flows
- missing states
- unrealistic transitions
- copy gaps
- demo risks before stakeholder review
